data.body: IMPL NOTE (plan-review cycle 2 residual): (1) The findings_hash construction uses stability.finding_hash() with a synthetic composite dict (pipe-joined file/line_range/category across sorted tuples). This is non-standard usage of the per-finding API but produces deterministic comparison across cycles. Add an inline code comment documenting the aggregation approach so future readers don't confuse it with per-finding hashing. (2) The comment 'pr_number=None skips PR-comment posting' is inaccurate — dispatch_review has no pr_number param. PR posting is driven by env vars; correct the comment during implementation. (3) The 'ledger-without-sidecar resume' unit-test path is partially covered by T10 E2E scenario 3; if implementing extra confidence is desired, add a unit test for that intermediate path (same-SHA ledger + no sidecar → pre-loop next_action does NOT return SHORT_CIRCUIT).
